'''Rik-tak''' was a cab driver and a [[Justice Action Network]] operative who operated in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He overheard a lot of information from his passengers that was of interest to the JAN. Rik-tak was a colleague and pen pal of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Kelsek]], who operated in the suburbs of [[Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy]] to recruit more JAN operatives.<ref name="LOTE" />

Rik-tak had rust-brown [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and, like all of this [[Species/Legends|species]], had a whip-like tail, clawed hands and an elongated snout with large [[Tooth/Legends|incisors]]. He wore an oversized brown cloak with a tight hood and a belt with numerous pockets and pouches. Although his etiquette was not great he was generally regarded as friendly.<ref name="LOTE" />
